name: Alpha Strike
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession.  If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks.  Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!

I want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work adventurer, or we'll remain at this impasse!
narrative.objectives: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, adventurer.

With their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...

There must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Time is running out, adventurer! If you're not here to report that you've taken out the Alphas, then you're wasting time!

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 42 to 48, 23,150 XP in all.

quests.name: War on the Woodpaw
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Alpha Strike
quests.objectiveText: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.

quests.name: Woodpaw Investigation
quests.objectiveText: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Battle Plans
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Stinglasher
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore.
